label: preparing
what: Builder, baker, innkeeper and freight are coordinating a discreet gathering in the town hall for day 1 at 18:00, with 200 fresh loaves on four great-hall tables and eight installed lanterns. Builder explicitly asked that it not be discussed with the mayor. Secretary knowingly helps clarify arrangements and payment, though there is no evidence she was an original organizer. Builder has accepted the 101-emerald credit obligation but lacks funds. The gathering may celebrate my forty years of service, but its purpose is unconfirmed; neighbour knows of lanterns and delivery arrangements, without clear evidence of organizing the concealed gathering.
